The '''[[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] religion''' revolved around the deity called the [[Scorekeeper/Legends|Scorekeeper]], who awarded the Trandoshans [[Jagannath point/Legends|Jagannath points]] for every kill and at a Trandoshans' Death would tally those Jagannath to determine their placement in the Afterlife based on how many they had acquired.
